_note: The relations a page must satisfy. tools/geometry.mjs checks exactly these and nothing else: a relation that is not declared is not judged, because a guess prints false positives and a gate with false positives gets switched off. inset = block siblings share both edges; centre = a centred stack shares its centre; columns = rows of one grid agree on column edges; rows = one list's rows share a height; padding = a named container carries at least its declared inner padding; rhythm = every padding and gap is a step or the sum of two.
